data.text:
Stay with us at the Sunstar Motel!

10% discount for veterans and seniors.

Located in central Muldraugh, with full air conditioning and color TV

Food available separately in our diner!

Rates:
Standard Double/Twin singles: $25
Double and single twin: $30
Bedroom w/double bed and living room: $40

Special rates for daytime 'meetings'!

118 Dixie Highway, Muldraugh, KY
